purpose: Resolve the frozen no-carry-across-missing-or-invalid-report rule conservatively and deterministically before materializing any daily state or measuring capacity.

conservative_state_algorithm.partition_activation_source_date: minimum displayed announcement_date among valid rows in that report_date partition
conservative_state_algorithm.partition_activation_availability: first local trading session strictly after partition_activation_source_date
conservative_state_algorithm.active_report_period_on_target_session: maximum report_date whose partition_activation_availability is on or before the target session
conservative_state_algorithm.global_reset_rule: At partition activation, every older report-period value is discarded for every instrument before any same-session new-period update. This deliberately resets names that have not yet filed, are absent, or had an invalid row.
conservative_state_algorithm.instrument_value_availability: Within the active report period only, a valid instrument value becomes usable on the first local trading session strictly after its own displayed announcement_date.
conservative_state_algorithm.late_older_correction_rule: A later-displayed row for an older report_date never supersedes an already activated newer report period.
conservative_state_algorithm.age_anchor: displayed announcement_date of the retained active-period instrument row
conservative_state_algorithm.reason: The earliest market-wide evidence that a new report period exists is observable without future data. Clearing all older values at that point is one-sided conservative: it can reduce coverage but cannot create an earlier factor value or carry an invalid/missing issuer forward.

materialization_targets.capacity: only the frozen non-overlapping three-session rebalance grid from the 2019-2025 local calendar

gate_order: revalidate the full source and this state algorithm without comparison fields or prices
materialize only capacity-grid states and run the frozen capacity gate
only after capacity passes, materialize 2025 daily states and load the exact 46 dense comparison fields
report the eight sparse fields only through the already frozen economic-mechanism exclusion; do not use insufficient-session statistics to pass or fail
stop without prices or returns if either no-return gate fails
prohibited_actions: naively carry the latest valid row across a newly activated report partition
use report_date itself as an availability date
let a late correction to an older report period overwrite a newer active period
alter the factor, direction, reset rule, 550-day age, capacity threshold, dense catalog, sparse rule, or quality gate after materialization
read prices, returns, scores, selections, sizes, or orders before all no-return gates pass
